business_summary: Sambhaav Media Limited engages in print media and audio video media business in India. The company operates through Media and Allied Business, and Technology and Allied Business Segments. It offers Sambhaav Metro, an afternoon-daily that provides a mix of local news, business, religion, lifestyle, and scoops; and Abhiyyan, a weekly magazine. The company also operates VTV News, a Gujarati news channel; Wise TV, an in-transit TV channel; and FM radio stations in Gujarat, Ladakh, and Jammu. In addition, it offers integrated vehicle tracking and passenger information systems; and electric smart power fence. It operates www.sambhaav.com, www.VTVGujarthi.com, www.abhiyaanmagazine.com, www.topfm.in, and www.vtvnews.co.in web portals for news, entertainment, gaming, and knowledge sharing activities; and iOS and android-based mobile applications for news, entertainment, and knowledge sharing. The company was formerly known as Pearl Energy and Infrastructures Limited. Sambhaav Media Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
